Nemotron local input counter v0.3.1

The tokenizer assets originate from NVIDIA's public
nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 repository at revision
a9904d24bcc1d289a1950fa9d2b978c47cf903b9.
See LICENSE.NVIDIA for the accompanying NVIDIA license.

The pinned served template includes the Nemotron serving profile used for
this verification. Asset hashes and the scope of dated checks are recorded
in manifest.json. No customer payloads, credentials, model weights or
third-party dependency binaries are included in this bundle.

Dependencies are installed separately from requirements.txt and remain
subject to their respective licenses. This counter provides bounded local
input accounting; it does not provide a service SLA or billing guarantee.
